title: Universal Fano-Holevo Sample-Complexity Lower Bound for Single-Qubit DCP Receivers
claims: Each single-qubit DCP state rho(theta, gamma) carries Holevo capacity at most chi_1(gamma) = 1 - h_2((1 + gamma)/2) >= gamma^2 / (2 ln 2) bits.

By quantum subadditivity and Fano's inequality, any collective or adaptive receiver recovering s in Z_q^n with error probability at most delta requires N_copies >= ((1 - delta) * n * log_2(q) - h_2(delta)) / (1 - h_2((1 + gamma)/2)) = Omega(n log_2(q) / gamma^2).
favorable_controls: 32-bit secret space (n=8, q=16) across gamma in {0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.80, 1.00} at delta=0.01
